review_history.reason: Head Spa read and copy-safe composition were strong, but amber lighting, spa decor and model/beauty-ad tone were slightly too strong for the intended small, approachable Fukuoka dry-headspa context. Revision used the one allowed regeneration.

Head-to-hand technique is immediately legible, the room reads as a small calm salon rather than a hotel or medical setting, the left side provides natural hero-copy space, and the client/hand/ear/neck/bed geometry is visually coherent at review scale.
